about: Catalog edits the Apps Script applies when the catalog is read with ?tab=Gifts&edits=1 (applyPendingEdits_ in docs/apps-script.gs). Each edit applies once, by id. set: change one cell only if it still holds `expect` and the row's Gift is `gift`. note: append ' | text' to Feedback. append: add a new gift row (ID left blank, filled automatically). values.Gift: BugView 5X Magnifier and Quick-Release Bug Catcher
values.Description: A one-handed bug catcher with a built-in 5X magnifier lets kids trap a beetle or spider, study it up close without touching it, and release it unharmed, which makes backyard bug hunts easy for small hands.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 at Dalia's request (trending kids' magnifying glass) | Rating: 4.7 from 8,195 (Amazon), 4.87 from 31 (carson.com); seller: Carson Optical (NY optics maker, 30+ years), sold direct and at Amazon and Walmart; no BBB rating or Trustpilot page found | Best-reviewed kids' magnifier, proposed in place of the viral TikTok screen microscope, which sells only under generic house brands

values.Gift: HG-6402P 8-Bar Curved Plug-In Heated Towel Rack, Mirror Polish
values.Description: An 8-bar curved towel warmer in mirror-polished stainless steel that mounts on the wall and plugs into a standard outlet, so no electrician is needed. It heats to about 130°F in 30 minutes, warming towels and drying them between showers.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 to replace the Amba T-2536 (hardwired, not on Amazon); Dalia prefers a rack over a bucket. Rating: 4.3 from 73 (Amazon, B07GRLJBGP); the brushed (4.2 from 217) and matte black (3.8 from 48) finishes of this model fall short, so the mirror polish is the passing finish. Seller: Amazon listing sold by Just Bathrooms and shipped by Amazon (96% positive, 142 seller ratings); Heatgene Trustpilot is unclaimed with 1 review, no complaint pattern found. Price: $272.99 on Amazon and $272.99 on heatgene.com, in stock on both.
